svg.title: IDS meta-study pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Data-flow architecture for OpenAlex and GitHub discovery, keyword, zero-shot NLI, LLM and ensemble classification, rated evaluation, reconciliation, plotting, and export.
svg.text: Discovery feeds comparable classifier families; rated evaluation and catalogue reporting remain separate outputs.
Direct queries and survey references form one deduplicated paper pool before evidence-based screening.
batch fetch; score; repeat to convergence
Native best-match results are selected before repository evidence is enriched and scored.
Comparable classifiers; only LLM and Ensemble feed catalogues.
• cached metadata and README / abstract evidence
keyword rules | zero-shot NLI | repeated LLM
method predictions + saved score / vote audits
normalize all; vote LLM runs; combine models
validated rows + reasons + saved NLI scores
group releases or forks; rank canonical member
build descriptive role, domain, and timeline views
Offline scoring compares Keyword, NLI, every LLM, and Ensemble on the same versioned source benchmark.
resolve fixtures; score operational / strict / selective
saved NLI scores + configured cutoff grid
Solid cards transform data • Dashed cards persist or transfer data • x = per-query sample size • y = retained collection size
